def: A benchmark of 75 Kaggle competitions on which agents are scored against human leaderboards.
The 22 low-complexity competitions of MLE-bench, about 158 GB of data against 3.3 TB for the full set.
A benchmark in which agents replicate 20 ICML 2024 papers from scratch, graded by rubrics and an LLM judge.
A set of seven open-ended research-engineering environments with human expert baselines at fixed time budgets.
An 8-task subset of FML-bench that drops the high-variance continual-learning and unlearning tasks.
A confidence interval for a proportion that behaves well at small counts and near 0 or 1.
The spread of a score across repeated runs on the same tasks; it excludes variation from the choice of tasks.
